changes_diff_error: Could not load the diff: {message} (it is gone once the Gateway restarts)
changes_diff_oversized: The file is over 2 MiB; the Gateway did not keep a copy, so there is no diff.
changes_diff_truncated: Showing the first {shown} lines; {rest} more not shown.
changes_empty: No changes recorded for this session yet.
changes_empty_hint: The Gateway takes a snapshot before and after each turn's tool calls and diffs them to find the files that changed. Records only live in this Gateway process, so turns from before a restart have none.
changes_foot: Changes come from git snapshots the Gateway takes before and after each turn's tool calls, so edits made by the shell are included; files outside a repository are tracked only through write and edit. Changes that were already uncommitted before the turn started are not counted. Records only live in this Gateway process.
chats_empty_body: Side chats are optional. Use one to keep a topic apart from the main chat.
composer_archived: This session is archived and read-only
composer_attach_blocked: An attachment failed to upload — remove it before sending
composer_attach_wait: Attachments are still uploading — send once they're done
composer_ring_none: This conversation has not called the model yet
config_call_timeout_desc: How long a single tool call may run.
config_compaction_desc: When the context is nearly full, earlier conversation is condensed into a summary.
config_confirm_timeout_desc: When unattended, how long to wait for you to approve an outward tool; no answer by then means it does not run.
config_desc: The common few; changes apply right away. Everything else lives in the config file, which the Gateway picks up when you save it.
config_embed_restart: The memory embedding model only changes after a Gateway restart: run komo gateway restart in a terminal. The index is rebuilt automatically for the new model, and until it is ready retrieval uses keywords only; relevance thresholds were calibrated for the old model and may need retuning.
config_memory_embedding_desc: Turns text into vectors for retrieval. Changing it takes a Gateway restart.
config_memory_enabled_desc: Extracts preferences, conventions and conclusions from conversations and brings them back when relevant.
config_memory_model_desc: The model used to extract and tidy memories; unset follows the default model.
config_receipt_start_only: {keys} only take effect after a Gateway restart.
config_reload_start_only: {keys} only take effect at startup; restart the Gateway (komo gateway restart).
config_result_bytes: Tool result limit for the model
config_result_bytes_desc: Beyond this the model gets a preview and a reference to the full result.
config_retrieval_mode_desc: How memories relevant to the current conversation are found.
config_stale: The file has changed since; not loaded yet.
cron_delete_warn: Once deleted it no longer runs; past runs stay in their sessions.
cron_finding_none: No cron jobs yet. Say “every Friday at 2pm…” in a conversation and komo will create one.
cron_overlap_skip: Skip this run if the last is still going
env_delete_ask: Once deleted, anything reading it gets no value.
env_delete_in_use: {names} still uses it; the Gateway will refuse.
env_desc: API keys and other credentials. Values can only be written, never shown; changes apply right away.
env_paste_hint: Or paste the contents of a .env file into the name box.
env_value_replace: New value, replaces the current one
error_config_invalid: The configuration did not pass validation.
error_conflict: That cannot be done in the current state.
error_corrupt: The Gateway found corrupted data and stopped the affected tasks.
error_internal: The Gateway ran into an error.
error_request_key_conflict: The same request key was used with different content.
error_unauthorized: Not signed in, or the session has expired.
error_version_conflict: The content was changed elsewhere; refresh and try again.
gateway_desc: The one process that holds state; the web app, TUI and CLI are all its clients.
home_error: Could not load the home session: {message}
matter_closure_conventions: These conventions still belong to it and keep going into conversations; change their owner or forget them on the Memory page:

match.countPlural=one: {count} trigger is still attached and was not deleted; detach it below if you no longer need it.
match.countPlural=other: {count} triggers are still attached and were not deleted; detach them below if you no longer need them.

matter_empty_areas: No areas in care: things with no end that you keep up (a weekly alert rotation) are areas.
matter_empty_goals: No goals in progress: things with an outcome that will end are goals, and can carry a due date.
matter_evidence_empty: None: this matter was created in the terminal or here directly.
matter_finding_counts: Goals in progress: {goals}. Areas in care: {areas}.
matter_finding_none: Nothing in progress. Say “start working on…” or “I’ll handle this” in a conversation and komo will note it.
matter_form_due_hint: Clear the date to remove the deadline.
matter_form_next_hint: One sentence; leave empty to clear
matter_form_waiting: Who or what are you waiting for
matter_memories_empty: None yet. When extracting, komo attaches related new observations to matters in progress.
matter_new_area: Area: no end, keep it up
matter_new_placeholder: e.g. Finish the owl release review this week
matter_new_standard_placeholder: e.g. Finish the on-call rotation before Monday each week
matter_no_jobs_before: No cron job to attach. Create one on the
matter_pick: Pick one to see its next step, triggers and memories.
matter_trigger_session_gone: Session is no longer in the list
matter_triggers_empty: None attached. komo often attaches a monitor when you are waiting on someone; recurring work can get a cron job.
mcp_desc: External tool servers. Add, change or remove them in the config file; here you see whether they are connected and which tools they offer.
mcp_disconnected_hint: Disconnected by hand: it won't reconnect on its own, and the model is told it is disconnected if it calls its tools. Click Connect to restore it; it also reconnects when the Gateway restarts.
mcp_needs_auth_hint: Run {command} in a terminal; once signed in, the next call connects automatically.
mcp_old_gateway: The running Gateway has no server list endpoint yet; after updating, each server and its tools are listed here.
mcp_tools_after_connect: Its tools are listed here once connected.
memindex_desc: The vector side of memory retrieval; when the index is unavailable, retrieval falls back to keywords.
memindex_rebuild_accepted: Rebuild submitted (generation {generation}); until it finishes in the background, retrieval falls back to keywords.
memindex_rebuild_running: A rebuild is already running; none was started.
memory_add_convention: Convention: followed whenever its condition holds
memory_add_hint: What you note here counts as said by you, so it is saved as confirmed.
memory_add_reference: Reference: consulted when looking things up and judging

match.countPlural=one: {count} memory laid out by the day it was noted
match.countPlural=other: {count} memories laid out by the day they were noted

memory_chart_empty: No memories yet: after a conversation has been idle for a while, komo distills preferences, facts and experiences from it.
memory_chart_note: One dot per memory, laid out by the day it was noted; the larger the dot, the more often it was brought into a conversation.
memory_evidence_none: No event evidence: you noted this one yourself, in the terminal or here.
memory_evidence_session_gone: The session is no longer in the list

match.countPlural=one: The {count} memory in effect has not been reviewed yet.
match.countPlural=other: None of the {count} memories in effect has been reviewed yet.

match.countPlural=one: {count} candidate is not recalled yet and waits for you to look.
match.countPlural=other: {count} candidates are not recalled yet and wait for you to look.

match.countPlural=one: The {count} memory in effect is confirmed by you.
match.countPlural=other: All {count} memories in effect are confirmed by you.

match.countPlural=one: {count} memory conflicts with another and is paused until you decide which one counts.
match.countPlural=other: {count} memories conflict with others and are paused until you decide which ones count.

memory_finding_none: No memory is in effect yet: once conversations go idle, komo distills them.
memory_finding_some_unseen: {unseen} of the {live} memories in effect have not been reviewed yet.
memory_forget_note: Once forgotten it is no longer brought into conversations, and the same source will not be distilled again. The original conversation is kept.
memory_hint_archived: Archived when its matter was closed; restored when that matter is reopened.
memory_hint_superseded: Replaced by a newer memory; no longer brought in.
memory_index_line: Search uses keywords + vectors · {model} · indexed {indexed} / {total} active
memory_none_always: No conventions yet: when you say things like “from now on…” or “by default…”, komo records them as conventions.
memory_none_live: No memory is in effect right now.
memory_none_out: No forgotten, superseded or archived memories.
memory_pick: Pick one to see where it came from and how often it was brought in.
memory_rungs_label: Filter by closeness to the conversation
memory_when_placeholder: e.g. when creating a release ticket and choosing a Platform
models_api_key_hint: Stored as an environment variable, not in the config.
models_api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved credential
models_del_embed: Delete embedding model {id}; its key stays in the environment variables.
models_del_embed_in_use: Memory is using it and the Gateway will refuse; switch memory to another embedding model first.
models_del_provider: Delete provider {id}; its API key stays in the environment variables.
models_del_provider_used: {count} models are still attached to it and the Gateway will refuse; clear its model catalog in Edit first, or attach them to another provider.
models_desc: Enter each provider's API key to use its models; changes take effect right away.
models_dup_provider: A provider named {id} already exists; pick another ID, or edit that one.
models_embed_dimensions_ph: Empty: use what the model returns
models_embed_key_hint: The key is stored as an environment variable, not in the config. Renaming also updates memory's reference.
models_embed_restart: The embedding model used by memory only takes effect after the Gateway restarts: run komo gateway restart in a terminal. The index is rebuilt automatically with the new model; until it is built, search uses keywords only. The relevance thresholds were tuned for the old model and may need adjusting.
models_kind_locked: The type can't change while models are attached; clear the model catalog and save first.
models_no_embedding: No embedding model yet: memory can only search by keyword. Add a provider with the Embedding type, then add a model to its catalog.
models_provider_id_hint_edit: Changing it also changes the models attached to it.
models_provider_id_hint_new: Starts with a letter. Models find this provider by it, and the credential variable name is derived from it.
models_standalone_only: Editable in the config file only
models_tab_custom_hint: Connect a relay, a self-hosted service, or any interface compatible with the OpenAI or Anthropic protocol. API address, protocol, and models are required.
models_tab_preset_hint: Pick one: the address and protocol are filled in, so you only need an API key and a model.
pair_hint: Run komo web in the terminal again to get a fresh link.
pair_missing_code: This link has no pairing code.
palette_empty_memory_hint: Type a keyword to search memories.
settings_status_error: Could not load the config check.
settings_status_issues: Gateway {version} is running, config check: {count} to review.
settings_status_ok: Gateway {version} is running, config check passed.
thread_empty_home: No messages in the home session yet.
trace_no_system_prompt: This request had no system prompt
trace_overview_label: Time overview: click a cell to open that record, drag horizontally to keep only that stretch, Esc to clear

match.countPlural=one: Only the {count} record in the selected stretch of the overview
match.countPlural=other: Only the {count} records in the selected stretch of the overview

unauthorized_body: Run komo web in a terminal; it opens a one-time link that pairs this browser.
unauthorized_title: This browser is not paired yet
browser_captured: Screenshot added to the composer; send it and the agent can see it
browser_empty_body: Type a URL, or preview a dev server running on this machine. Screenshots go into the composer and are sent to the agent with your message.
browser_detect_none: No dev server found on the common local ports.
conn_local_hint: Switch back to the Gateway on this machine; the app will reload.
conn_token_hint: Re-enter on every save. The token and headers are encrypted with the system keychain.
conn_headers_hint: One `Name: value` per line. Authorization, Cookie, Host and Origin can't be set.
conn_headers_saved: Saved: {names}. Saving replaces them with what you enter here.
